name: Blocks
lead: `game.blocks`: defines a pack's own blocks and amends the game's own, at load time.

functions.name: define
functions.description: Load-time only: a world may already be holding blocks of a definition, so one that arrived later would change the rules under the players standing on it. Define at the top of `main.luau`.

functions.name: amend
functions.description: Only the game's own blocks, never another pack's.

title: Blocks type
